    Profile

    Ryui is a young girl from Realhaven. She has a strong desire to live prosperously, even if the environment may not be so fitting. She believes that nothing is impossible, and likes to challenge anything that comes her way. She made her magic tools by herself, and the Holy Guard are amazed by the high quality.

    Origin: Slothstein
    Gender: Female
    Height: 156cm
    Weight: 41kg
    Birthday: Jun 19
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Dark Magic Dragon
    Likes: Beautiful stories
    Hobbies: Self cleansing (within)
    Illust: 渡り棒（G-ROW）
    CV: MoeMi
